properties.label: Paper exhibition mat
properties.text: Set a large white exhibition mat on warm paper, with a tall narrow title at upper left, specimen metadata in the opposite corner, a saturated printed slab in the lower quarter and a large clean paper interval between them.

properties.label: Narrow editorial serif
properties.text: Use Instrument Serif or a similarly narrow editorial serif for the title, balanced by small specimen metadata.

properties.label: Warm paper and violet ink
properties.text: Use warm off-white #f3f2ee, charcoal ink and saturated pink-to-violet printed color.

properties.label: Bounded halftone print slab
properties.text: Confine a crisp, inspectable halftone region, fine crop marks and registration details to the printed composition rather than applying a noisy full-screen filter.

properties.label: Physical paper edges
properties.text: Use visible mat edges and subtle print texture to make the sheet read as a physical mounted print.

properties.label: Still print presentation
properties.text: Keep the printed composition still; only the functional action receives short confirmation motion.

properties.label: Complete mat acceptance
properties.text: Keep the complete mat inside its stage. Do not crop its corners or cover the ink slab with navigation; at narrow widths move metadata into the reading flow.
